/scripts.value:
on MoveQuestion
	repeat with xQuestion = 1 to the number of lines of QuestionsForQuestionsList 
		switch
			case MoveQuestionUp = empty and MoveQuestionDown is not empty
				if line xQuestion of QuestionsForQuestionsList = MoveQuestionDown then
					put xQuestion into MoveQuestionOrderDownNumber
					if xQuestion = the number of lines of QuestionsForQuestionsList then
						// ITS THE LAST ONE, NO MOVEMENT NECESSARY
						put false into doQuestionMove 
					else
						put MoveQuestionOrderDownNumber + 1 into MoveQuestionOrderUpNumber
						put true into doQuestionMove
						put line MoveQuestionOrderUpNumber of QuestionsForQuestionsList into MoveQuestionUp
					end if
					exit repeat
				end if
				break
			case MoveQuestionDown = empty and MoveQuestionUp is not empty
				if line xQuestion of QuestionsForQuestionsList = MoveQuestionUp then
					put xQuestion into MoveQuestionOrderUpNumber
					if xQuestion = 1 then
						// ITS THE FIRST ONE, NO MOVEMENT NECESSARY
						put false into doQuestionMove 
					else
						// WE HAVE NUMBER THAT HAS TO MOVE UP
						put MoveQuestionOrderUpNumber - 1 into MoveQuestionOrderDownNumber
						put true into doQuestionMove
						put line MoveQuestionOrderDownNumber of QuestionsForQuestionsList into MoveQuestionDown
					end if
					exit repeat
				end if
				break
		end switch
	end repeat
	
	local tTable, tRecordIDs, tTarget, tOutputA,tRecordID,tInternalA
	local tRecordsToSync,tResultA
	
	if doQuestionMove = true then
		
		// GET THE RECORD THAT NEEDS TO GO UP // MoveQuestionUp
		put MoveQuestionUp into tRecordIDs
		put authedUserQuestionsTable into tTable
		put "local" into tTarget
		put cdb_read(tTable,tRecordIDs,tTarget) into tOutputA
		put tRecordIDs into tRecordsToSync
		
		// UPDATE ORDER NUMBER
		subtract 1 from 	tOutputA[tRecordIDs]["QuestionOrder"]	
		
		// SAVE THE RECORD
		put authedUserQuestionsTable into tTable
		put MoveQuestionUp into tRecordID
		put "local" into tTarget
		cdb_update tOutputA[tRecordIDs],tTable,tRecordID,tTarget,tInternalA
		
		
		// GET THE RECORD THAT NEEDS TO GO DOWN // MoveQuestionDown
		put MoveQuestionDown into tRecordIDs
		put authedUserQuestionsTable into tTable
		put "local" into tTarget
		
		put cdb_read(tTable,tRecordIDs,tTarget) into tOutputA
		put lf & tRecordIDs after tRecordsToSync
		
		// UPDATE ORDER NUMBER
		add 1 to tOutputA[tRecordIDs]["QuestionOrder"]
		
		// SAVE THE RECORD
		put authedUserQuestionsTable into tTable
		put MoveQuestionDown into tRecordID
		put "local" into tTarget
		cdb_update tOutputA[tRecordIDs],tTable,tRecordID,tTarget,tInternalA
		
		
		// SYNC RECORD IN CLOUD
		put cdb_sync(tRecordsToSync,tTable,"local",false,true) into tResultA
	end if 
end MoveQuestion
